purpose: One additive train-only object support structural objective; synthetic CPU implementation validation only.

formula.weightBasis: same coefficient as existing core spatial term; not tuned against validation
formula.aggregation: equal mean over applicable typed roles; no pixel-count weighting
formula.noApplicableRoles: differentiable zero new term with explicit not_applicable status; no sample removal or success claim
formula.newTermTarget: detached original train RGB; never review scores, failed previews or non-train RGB

support.source: existing authoritative23channel facts plus instance table
support.coverage: union of existing clipped ObjectView.support_mask per typed role; no new dilation radius

acceptance: Inherited objective source bytes unchanged and total/parts retained
Exact existing support ownership reproduced, including overlaps and canvas boundaries
Non-train inputs and malformed shape/channel/instance/finite data rejected
Only predictions receive new-term gradients; target, conditions, masks remain detached
Correct structure scores better than rearranged structure; constant/empty roles are not zero-successes
Gradient reaches simple synthetic object RGB branches; no real model, optimizer or CUDA
Candidate code is not imported or selected by production training entries
Independent CPU tests and documentation/encoding/diff checks pass

evidenceBasis.interpretation: Single sample supports a bounded hypothesis, not a proven root cause or promise of improved quality.
